title: 第7章 这小白脸是谁第8章 泊秦淮
content_zh:
陪本女神在金大北园和南园浪一圈？江凡无语瞥了眼李富婆，你这是拿哥当挡箭牌，还是拿哥当小白脸，是不是得瑟的过头了！
唉，哥这该死的魅力，才在金大门口站了一分钟，周围就聚集了数十个花痴女生，更有一些女生拿着相机偷偷拍照，就差找江凡要签名。
没办法，谁让李富婆是债主，江凡戴上口罩，挽住李富婆纤纤玉臂，一对俊男靓女缓步走进北园，瞬间吸引不少金大师生目光，俊郎如玉映朝霞，佳人似花绽芳华！
“我男友，中药大雷哥！”
李子茜热情向商学院两个校友介绍着江凡，江凡的颜值、身材杠杠的，两人挽着手臂在校园里逛一圈，脸上倍有面子，走路都带风。
“雷哥好，雷嫂好”
，商学院两个女生羡慕看向眼前一对金童玉女，两人还真是良才女貌，要是李富婆的那些追求者见到江凡，会不会自惭形秽的抱头大哭。
扫了眼周边男生那想杀人的目光，江凡只感觉给李富婆做挡箭牌亏大了，李富婆驾驶一辆数百万的法拉利跑车，颜值秒杀一众女明星，金大追求者不知凡几，鬼知道他得罪了多少李富婆追求者。
“李富婆，情敌太多，挡箭牌不好干，得加钱！”
李子茜莞尔轻笑，江凡是不是掉进了钱眼里，上次见面让她卖掉法拉利借钱，这次见面又让她加钱，真是大煞风景，随即伸出左手五指，“没问题，一周来金大陪姐玩一天。”
“一天五千？没问题，保证随叫随到，服务周到！”
一天五千，你还真敢狮子大开口，你怎么不去抢，一天五千也不是不行，那姐就当老鸨，给你介绍些金陵的离异富婆，说不定姐还能赚五千呢。
---
什么，李芷若有男朋友，还带着男朋友在北园闲逛？甘永庆额头上的青筋暴起，瞳孔紧缩，眼神冰冷锐利，犹如寒冬中的冰刺，教室里空气似乎凝固，令众人不寒而栗。
小弟张道雄胆颤心惊点头，刚才去超市买饮料和香烟，无意间看到李子茜同一个高大帅气男生，手挽手在北园校园撒狗粮，那是令人羡慕嫉妒恨。
张道雄默默同情甘永庆三秒，你一个开路虎的追求人家开法拉利，而且李子茜好像是大家族子弟，你这不是老牛吃嫩草，而是癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉，早点放手的好，有一种爱叫做放手，为爱放弃天长地久。
好，好，好，甘永庆双拳捏的咯吱作响，在金陵这一亩三分地上，居然有人活腻歪敢同他甘永庆抢女人，真是望乡台上高歌，不知死的鬼！
---
金陵大学不愧是百年名校，红砖墙、青瓦顶，不少百年建筑庄重而典雅，各种花草树木郁郁葱葱，朝气蓬勃的学生坐在凉亭、草坪、长凳等地方学习，营造出一种宁静和谐的氛围。
“怎么样？”

李子茜笑着问道，金陵的大学有数十所，要说校园环境最好的，那百年名校金陵大学肯定首屈一指，而且学习氛围丝毫不弱于燕京的清北！
“校园环境优美，建筑历史悠久，文化底蕴深厚，学习气氛浓厚，只是校园太小了些，一万多学生挤在八百亩的北园上课，你不感觉压抑吗？”
李子茜暗暗翻白眼，你这不是说的废话嘛，各大高校在四年前突然扩招，来不及建设新校区，全国哪个高校不是挤的一塌糊涂，有些高校的宿舍楼甚至是十人间。
“怎么样，姐没骗你吧，四位美女放在你们中药大，全是校花级别的存在吧！”
李子茜得意瞥了眼江凡，让你来蹭顿大餐，五个美女作陪，你还不情不愿，搞的姐像骗你似的，随即热情介绍起四位好友。
好吧，四个美女确实很漂亮，可你们五人全部来自燕京，大一、大三、研一也就算了，商学院、法学院、医学院，年龄不同，学院不同，关系却如此熟络，八成从小住在一个大院，极有可能是军区大院子弟。
什么，秦家弃少江凡，还是上个月遭雷劈的倒霉蛋，四女震惊的合不拢嘴，大眼瞪小眼，面面相觑，这是不是帅的有些过分了，“你真的是上个月在玄武湖公园被雷电击中的学生？”
“如假包换，遭雷劈之后，身体进行了二次发育，长高了五六公分，体格更加强壮，大脑也异常活跃，比以前聪明了不少。”
江凡大大方方说道，哥不是外星人，身体遭遇雷击发生变异，上面总不能拿哥当小白鼠切片研究吧。
四女不可置信看向江凡，又看向富婆李子茜，遭雷劈的人又不少，绝大部分非死即残，雷公电母不姓江，也不姓秦，可江凡遭雷劈后，不但无丝毫大碍，反而福利多多，难道江凡上辈子拯救了地球人？
“好人不长命，祸害遗千年”
，李子茜无奈摊开双手，江凡就是这么邪门，“上个月我去中药大看望江凡，今天再次见面也是大吃一惊，可能江凡敲了八辈子木鱼，才走了狗屎运！”
“江凡，最近姐身边的苍蝇有些多，什么时候你有时间了来客串下姐的男朋友，赶走那些苍蝇。”
张思雯笑着说道，法学院那些苍蝇要是看到姐有这么帅的男朋友，应该会彻底打消追姐的念头。
“思雯姐，小妹刚同江凡挽着手臂绕北园和南园逛了一圈，你现在当着小妹的面抢男朋友，这让小妹情何以堪啊。”
李子茜嫣然一笑，江凡不愧是被雷劈过的男人，杀伤力、魅力对于女生来说简直就是无懈可击！
闲聊几分钟，众人向着校外走去，一位男神五位女神的组合，再次吸引不少学生的注意力，可惜只能徒呼奈何，人与人的命运不同，大概率会在出生的那一刻定格。
鼓楼附近有不少百年老字号的高档餐厅，玄武湖公园周边也有很多高档餐厅，可众女偏偏在秦淮河那边订了餐厅，那地方鱼龙混杂，环境也嘈杂的很，真心有些搞不明白。
好吧，网络上的信息不靠谱，宿舍的金陵土着也没有见过大世面，江凡犹如没见过世面土包子，打量着秦淮河畔的私房菜馆六朝小院，亭台楼榭，假山流水，吃饭的地方搞的这么花里胡哨，不由得暗暗庆幸今晚只是来蹭饭，另有他人买单。
也不能说江凡没有见过大世面，修士皆是以辟谷丹解决温饱问题，谁会吃饱了撑着花费宝贵的时间品尝什么美食，即使那些修真坊市的酒楼，装修也非常简单粗暴！

“这小白脸是谁？”

content_en:
Accompany this goddess to take a stroll in Jinda North Park and South Park? Jiang Fan glanced at Mrs. Li speechlessly, "Are you using your brother as a shield, or are you using your brother as a love interest? Are you going too far?"
Alas, my damn charm, I just stood at the gate of Jinmen for a minute, and dozens of nymphomaniac girls gathered around me. Some girls even took photos secretly with cameras, and almost asked Jiang Fan for his autograph.
There was no way, who made Mrs. Li the creditor? Jiang Fan put on a mask and held Mrs. Li's slender arms. A pair of handsome men and beautiful women slowly walked into the North Garden, instantly attracting the attention of many Jin teachers and students. The handsome man reflected the morning glow, and the beautiful woman blossomed like a flower!
"My boyfriend, Brother Big Lei of Chinese Medicine!"
Li Ziqian enthusiastically introduced Jiang Fan to the two alumni of the business school. Jiang Fan had good looks and a good figure. The two of them walked around the campus arm in arm. They looked very proud and walked with wind.
"Hello Brother Lei, hello Sister-in-law Lei"
, the two girls from the business school looked at the golden couple in front of them with envy. They were really talented and beautiful women. If the suitors of rich woman Li saw Jiang Fan, would they hold their heads in shame and cry.
Glancing at the murderous looks of the boys around him, Jiang Fan only felt that he was losing money by being a shield for Rich Woman Li. Rich Woman Li drove a multi-million Ferrari sports car, and her looks killed many female stars in an instant. She had countless suitors, and he offended who knows how many of Rich Woman Li's suitors.
"Mr. Li, there are too many love rivals, and it's hard to use a shield. You need to pay more!"
Li Ziqian smiled lightly and wondered if Jiang Fan had fallen into the eyes of money. The last time they met, she was asked to sell her Ferrari to borrow money, and this time they asked her to add more money. It was really a disgrace. Then she stretched out the five fingers of her left hand and said, "No problem, Jin Da will spend one day a week with my sister."
"Five thousand a day? No problem, guaranteed to be on call and provide considerate service!"
Five thousand a day, you really dare to talk like a lion, why don't you go and rob, five thousand a day is not a problem, then I will be a madam and introduce you to some rich divorced women in Jinling, maybe I can earn five thousand.
---
What, Li Zhiruo has a boyfriend, and she takes her boyfriend to hang out in Beiyuan? The veins on Gan Yongqing's forehead popped out, his pupils were constricted, and his eyes were cold and sharp, like ice thorns in the cold winter. The air in the classroom seemed to be frozen, making everyone shudder.
The younger brother Zhang Daoxiong nodded fearfully. He just went to the supermarket to buy drinks and cigarettes, and accidentally saw Li Ziqian and a tall and handsome boy, hand in hand, spreading dog food on the Beiyuan campus. It made people envious and jealous.
Zhang Daoxiong silently sympathized with Gan Yongqing for three seconds. You drive a Land Rover and pursue someone who drives a Ferrari, and Li Ziqian seems to be a child of a big family. You are not an old cow eating tender grass, but a toad who wants to eat swan meat. It is better to let go as soon as possible. There is a kind of love called letting go. Giving up for love lasts forever.
Okay, okay, okay, Gan Yongqing's fists clenched loudly. In this three-quarter acre of land in Jinling, there is someone who dares to steal a woman from him, Gan Yongqing. What a ghost who doesn't know how to die!
---
Jinling University is worthy of being a century-old famous school. It has red brick walls, green tile roofs, many century-old buildings are solemn and elegant, and there are all kinds of lush flowers, plants and trees. Vibrant students sit in pavilions, lawns, benches and other places to study, creating a peaceful and harmonious atmosphere.
"How's it going?"
Li Ziqian asked with a smile. There are dozens of universities in Jinling. To say that the campus environment is the best, Jinling University, a century-old prestigious university, must be second to none, and the learning atmosphere is not inferior to Qingbei in Yanjing!
"The campus environment is beautiful, the buildings have a long history, the culture is profound, and the learning atmosphere is strong. However, the campus is too small. More than 10,000 students are crowded into the 800-acre North Park for classes. Don't you feel depressed?"
Li Ziqian secretly rolled her eyes, aren't you talking nonsense? Major universities suddenly expanded their enrollment four years ago, and there was no time to build new campuses. Every university in the country is not overcrowded. Some universities even have dormitories for ten people.
"How's it going, sister?I'm not lying to you. If you put these four beauties in your Chinese Medicine University, they would all be campus beauties! "
Li Ziqian glanced at Jiang Fan proudly and asked you to have a feast with five beauties as companions. You were reluctant, as if she was lying to you, and then introduced her four friends enthusiastically.
Well, the four beauties are indeed beautiful, but the five of you are all from Yanjing, not to mention freshmen, juniors, and first-year graduate students. Business school, law school, and medical school. You are of different ages and colleges, but you are so familiar with each other. Most of you have lived in the same compound since you were young, and you are most likely your brothers in the military district compound.
What, Jiang Fan, the abandoned young man of the Qin family, was still the unlucky guy who was struck by lightning last month. The four girls were so shocked that they couldn’t open their mouths from ear to ear, staring at each other with big eyes and small eyes. Isn’t this too handsome? “Are you really the student who was struck by lightning in Xuanwu Lake Park last month? "
"If it's true, after being struck by lightning, my body underwent secondary development. I grew five or six centimeters taller. My body became stronger, my brain was also extremely active, and I was much smarter than before. "
Jiang Fan said openly that I am not an alien. My body mutated after being struck by lightning. The superiors cannot use me as a guinea pig for slice-up research.
The four girls looked at Jiang Fan in disbelief, and then at the rich woman Li Ziqian. There were many people struck by lightning, and most of them died or were disabled. The Thunder God and the Lightning Mother were not named Jiang, nor Qin. But after Jiang Fan was struck by lightning, not only did he not suffer any serious problems, but he also received many benefits. Could it be that Jiang Fan saved the people of the earth in his previous life?
"Good people don't live long, but disasters last for thousands of years."
, Li Ziqian spread her hands helplessly, Jiang Fan is so evil, "Last month I went to the University of Traditional Chinese Medicine to visit Jiang Fan, and I was shocked when we met again today. Maybe Jiang Fan had spent eight lifetimes knocking wooden fish before he got lucky! "
"Jiang Fan, there have been a lot of flies around my sister recently. When do you have time, you can come as my boyfriend and drive away those flies. "
Zhang Siwen said with a smile that if those flies in the law school saw that my sister had such a handsome boyfriend, they would completely give up the idea of pursuing my sister.
"Sister Siwen, I just walked arm in arm with Jiang Fan around the North and South Gardens. Now you are robbing me of your boyfriend in front of my face. This makes me so embarrassed. "
Li Ziqian smiled brightly, Jiang Fan was indeed a man who had been struck by lightning, his lethality and charm were simply impeccable for girls!
After chatting for a few minutes, everyone walked towards the outside of the school. The combination of a male god and five goddesses once again attracted the attention of many students. Unfortunately, they could only do nothing. People's destiny is different, and it will most likely be fixed at the moment of birth.
There are many century-old high-end restaurants near the Drum Tower, and there are also many high-end restaurants around Xuanwu Lake Park, but the girls chose to book a restaurant on the Qinhuai River side. The place was a mixed bag of good and bad, and the environment was very noisy. I really couldn't understand it.
Well, the information on the Internet is unreliable, and the Jinling natives in the dormitory have never seen the world. Jiang Fan is like a country bumpkin who has never seen the world. He looks at the Liuchao Courtyard of the private restaurant on the bank of the Qinhuai River, with pavilions, pavilions, rockeries and flowing water. The dining place is so fancy that he can't help but secretly feel lucky that he is just here to have a meal tonight, and someone else is paying the bill.
It cannot be said that Jiang Fan has not seen the world. Monks all use Bigu Pill to solve their food and clothing problems. Who would spend precious time tasting delicious food when they are full? Even those restaurants in Xiuzhenfang City are very simple and crude in decoration!
"Who is this pretty boy? "
